<a name="Inline"></a>
## func [Inline](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/plugin/register.go#L30>)

```go [register.go]
func Inline(id, name string, onInit func(ctx *tako.Context))
```

Inline is a convenience wrapper for creating and registering simple plugins without needing to define a struct. It defines a plugin with the given ID and name, and executes the provided function during the OnInit phase.

```
func init() {
    plugin.Inline("hello", "Hello Plugin", func(ctx *tako.Context) {
        ctx.Logger().Info("Hello from functional plugin!")
    })
}
```

<a name="Register"></a>
## func [Register](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/plugin/register.go#L17>)

```go [register.go]
func Register(manifest Manifest, factory Factory)
```

Register is a convenience wrapper for registering a plugin from an init\(\) function. It is equivalent to plugin.GlobalRegistry.Register\(manifest, factory\).

Typical usage in your plugin's init.go:

```
func init() {
    plugin.Register(Manifest, func() plugin.Lifecycle { return &Plugin{} })
}
```

The factory function \(not the struct\) is stored. The Plugin Manager calls it at boot time, so each plugin gets a clean, isolated instance.

<a name="Lifecycle"></a>
## type [Lifecycle](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/plugin/manifest.go#L29-L34>)

Lifecycle defines the events in a plugin's lifecycle.

```go [manifest.go]
type Lifecycle interface {
    OnInit(_ *tako.Context) error
    OnActivate(_ *tako.Context) error
    OnDeactivate(_ *tako.Context) error
    OnDestroy(_ *tako.Context) error
}
```

<a name="Manager.Shutdown"></a>
### func \(\*Manager\) [Shutdown](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/plugin/manager.go#L187>)

```go [manager.go]
func (m *Manager) Shutdown()
```

Shutdown calls OnDeactivate then OnDestroy on all successfully booted plugins, in reverse boot order. Each call is wrapped in the panic sandbox so a single misbehaving plugin cannot prevent the rest from cleaning up.

<a name="Manifest"></a>
## type [Manifest](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/plugin/manifest.go#L17-L26>)

Manifest defines the metadata and dependencies for a plugin.

```go [manifest.go]
type Manifest struct {
    ID          string   // required — unique plugin ID
    Name        string   // required — display name
    Version     string   // required — semver string "MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH"
    Description string   // required — ≤ 120 chars
    Author      string   // optional
    Type        Type     // default: view
    Requires    []string // optional — hard dependencies (plugin IDs)
    Recommends  []string // optional — soft dependencies (plugin IDs)
}
```

<a name="NoopLifecycle"></a>
## type [NoopLifecycle](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/plugin/manifest.go#L47>)

NoopLifecycle provides no\-op implementations of the Lifecycle interface. Embed it in your plugin struct to avoid writing boilerplate for lifecycle hooks you don't need to override.

```
type Plugin struct {
    plugin.NoopLifecycle
    // your fields…
}

// Only override what you need:
func (p *Plugin) OnInit(ctx *tako.Context) error { … }
```

```go [manifest.go]
type NoopLifecycle struct{}
```
